results.title: South Korea vs Czechia Prediction, Lineups and Betting Tips
highlights:
South Korea vs Czechia prediction, lineups and betting tips for the FIFA World Cup 2026 Group A match on 12 June 2026. Son Heung-min preview, H2H record and correct score inside.
[...]
South Korea take on Czechia in Group A of the 2026 FIFA World Cup on Friday, 12 June 2026, with kick-off at 3:00 AM WAT. This is a crucial Group A fixture between two competitive European and Asian nations. Both sides know that a win here gives them a strong platform to qualify from the group. As a result, neither team can afford to start slowly.
[...]
Our prediction is a South Korea win. South Korea have a better squad at this level, particularly with Son Heung-min leading their attack. Moreover, they have shown the ability to beat European nations at World Cups before. Czechia are organised but lack th mye individual quality to match South Korea’s firepower.
[...]
| Market | Prediction |
| --- | --- |
| Match Result | South Korea Win |
| Correct Score | 2-1 |
| Both Teams to Score | Yes |
| Total Goals | Over 2.5 |
| Best Bet | South Korea Win & Both Teams to Score |
[...]
Czechia qualified for this World Cup through UEFA qualifying and are managed by Ivan Hasek. They play a structured 4-2-3-1 system that is hard to break down but can struggle to create chances against well-organised defences. Their key player is Tomas Soucek, the West Ham midfielder, who provides box-to-box energy and goals from deep.
[...]
However, Czechia lack pace in forward areas. As a result, they may struggle to hurt South Korea on the counter. Nevertheless, they are disciplined and have defensive quality through their experienced backline.
[...]
In addition, Czechia’s recent World Cup record is modest. They have not advanced beyond the group stage in their last two appearances. Therefore, they need a positive result in this opener to stay alive in the tournament.
[...]

The standout value bet here is South Korea to win with both teams scoring. Son Heung-min’s quality makes South Korea dangerous in any game. Furthermore, Czechia’s Patrik Schick is clinical enough to score even in a losing effort. Therefore, Both Teams to Score alongside a South Korea win offers the best combination of value and likelihood.
[...]
In addition, Over 2.5 Goals is worth backing. Both sides have scored in their last four competitive matches. Moreover, World Cup group openers between evenly matched nations often produce open, attacking football as both teams target a positive start. As a result, a game with three or more goals is very plausible.

results.title: Paraguay 2026 World Cup Preview: Squad, Schedule, Odds & Best Bets
highlights:
Paraguay returns to the FIFA World Cup after a 16-year absence, relying on a robust and experienced defence under manager Gustavo Alfaro. Their qualification was built on low-scoring, disciplined performances, making them tough opponents. While strong at the back and equipped with Premier League talent in Diego Gomez and exciting attackers like Julio Enciso, expectations of a lengthy run are low. Still, Paraguay could surprise in Group D against USA, Turkey, and Australia, with value in betting on low-scoring games rather than an outright win.
